title: Michael's strange sightings in Missouri, the Ozarks and Texas

tellings.quote: I have seen strange occurrences in Missouri, in the Ozarks,

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson, who says he was abducted by beings while serving at a South Dakota air base in 1977, says he has also seen "strange occurrences" in Missouri, in the Ozarks hill country and in Texas. He mentions them himself in passing, without describing what he saw or when.
